description: Revocation-epoch cache-admit conformance vectors (ADR_005 Section 5.7, iter-12). GV-EPOCH-1..6,8 are runner-backed via the epoch-gv binary (synoi-gateway/runtime/carrier/src/bin/epoch_gv.rs), which exercises gate_decision_cache_admit() with deterministic JSON inputs. GV-EPOCH-7 (TS bump-rule) is TS-test-backed via synoi-gateway/test/consult-epoch.test.ts and is NOT runner-shelled from this fixture.

status_summary.GV-EPOCH-4: runner-backed via epoch-gv (cache-admit layer); verify_gate_decision tamper-reject layer additionally covered by cargo test gv_epoch_4_signed_epoch_tamper_reject
status_summary.GV-EPOCH-7: TS-test-backed via synoi-gateway/test/consult-epoch.test.ts (GV-EPOCH-7-TS); not runner-shelled from this fixture

notes.gv_epoch_7_ts: GV-EPOCH-7 tests the TS-side bump rule: markProvisionallyBlocked() bumps revocation_epoch (allow-to-deny); unblockProvisionally() does not. This is a Node/gateway test (consult-epoch.test.ts), not a Rust cache-admit vector. The runner does not shell to it; it stays TS-test-backed.
notes.gv_epoch_4_layered: GV-EPOCH-4 has two defense layers: (1) verify_gate_decision rejects tampered core as PayloadCoreMismatch (cargo test), (2) cache_admit catches stale epoch even for a tampered value that bypassed sig-verify. epoch-gv covers layer 2 only.
notes.rebind_fixture: The gate-consult-rebind.json fixture was audited against consult-gate-router.ts. The gateway's GateDecisionContentCore DOES include revocation_epoch: number (main branch, line 140). The _gen-gate-consult-rebind.ts generator baseContentCore is MISSING this field and must be updated + regenerated.

vectors.name: gv-epoch-2-epoch-equal-served
vectors.claim: decision_epoch(7) == last_seen_epoch(7) must return ServeFromCache (within max-age, not sensitive)

vectors.name: gv-epoch-3-epoch-greater-adopts-and-serves
vectors.claim: decision_epoch(9) > last_seen_epoch(7) must return ServeFromCache (host was behind)

vectors.name: gv-epoch-4-signed-epoch-tamper-reject
vectors.claim: tampered epoch=3 with host=7 must return MustReconsult(StaleEpoch); cache-admit second defense layer

vectors.name: gv-epoch-5-epoch-monotonic-never-decreases
vectors.claim: poll sequence 3,5,4,5 leaves hwm=5; epoch=4 and epoch=3 are stale; epoch=5 serves

vectors.name: gv-epoch-6-missing-epoch-fail-closed
vectors.claim: missing / string / negative revocation_epoch all return MustReconsult(MissingOrBadEpoch)

vectors.name: gv-epoch-7-bump-on-allow-to-deny-only
vectors.claim: markProvisionallyBlocked() bumps revocation_epoch; unblockProvisionally() does not
vectors.note: Backed by synoi-gateway/test/consult-epoch.test.ts (GV-EPOCH-7-TS). Not runner-shelled from here.

vectors.name: gv-epoch-8-sensitive-kind-ignores-epoch
vectors.claim: revocation-sensitive kind returns RevocationSensitiveKind regardless of epoch value; sensitivity check runs before epoch check
